question: How are parts to be divided up to the sixfold interval limit?
premises: The limit extends to a sixfold interval.
Parts must be made within that range.
The division proceeds from one part.
inference: Parts should be made up to the sixfold interval, proceeding from one part.
uncertainties: The compound kṛtvaikabhāgataḥ is compact and interpreted as division starting from one part.
plain_english: Having made parts up to the sixfold interval, starting from one part.
